description: Henry Schein, Inc. is a solutions company for health care professionals powered by a network of people and technology, and it believes it is the world's largest provider of health care products and services primarily to office-based dental and medical practitioners as well as alternate sites of care, grounded in a commitment to serve as trusted advisors and help customers operate a more efficient and successful business so the practitioner can provide better clinical care. With 94 years of experience distributing health care products it has built a vast base of small, mid-sized and large customers in the dental and medical markets, serving more than one million customers worldwide, and its operations or affiliates are located in 34 countries and territories. It stocks a comprehensive selection of more than 300,000 branded and Henry Schein corporate brand products, supported by infrastructure including over 5.4 million square feet of space in 38 distribution centers and 0.6 million square feet in 17 manufacturing facilities.
